name: etabs-bridge
description: ETABS plugin + local API, MCP server and sample web app for reading ETABS models.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @etabs-bridge/client && npm run build -w @etabs-bridge/mock-bridge -w @etabs-bridge/mcp-server -w @etabs-bridge/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @etabs-bridge/client && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @etabs-bridge/client && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.mock: npm run build -w @etabs-bridge/client -w @etabs-bridge/mock-bridge && npm run start -w @etabs-bridge/mock-bridge
